router.query_support: all spatial queries in each position bin overlapping valid physical time; pure-pad bins remain native

purpose: Two official original-scene local edits: background screen replacement and dog-to-cat. Each Native is reviewed before corresponding forced submission.
condition_scope: Six actual Qwen/tag/reference/position clean condition blobs, AV noise and all20x0+final archives per run; same-source paired actual equality. No reference audio input.
source_event_annotations: Evaluation-only source observations. No hand-marked action window enters model or router.
cost: Record20NFE/20callbacks/1000blocks; Native0/ON450 routed blocks; capture time separate; no online observer.

evaluation.official: Pinned IVEBench Motion Fidelity on original valid physical prefix after fixed16/8 padding crop
evaluation.adaptation: Two source-selected complete official clips with exact mapping to24fps; retain both cases and all failures. Report task fidelity on both, then timing on eligible retained-action pairs.
evaluation.visibility_policy: 0144 keep all four people and their motions; larger billboard may legitimately occlude local pixels. 0166 retain both women/orchard actions; cat shape and animal behavior are edited. Hands/branches may occlude joints. UNKNOWN remains unobservable.

acceleration_axes.weights: Same four checkpoint SHAs and nine core SHAs as prior H3 experiments
acceleration_axes.runtime: Host41 frozen R76 runtime, unchanged six numerical modules; per-job exact admission.
acceleration_axes.attention: Native PyTorch SDPA via inherited audited block wrapper; H3 Sage patch absent
acceleration_axes.linear_backend: Triton INT8 with inherited row chunking guard
acceleration_axes.sampler: Euler20 manual shifted video sigmas12/audio3, CFG1
acceleration_axes.cache: Default Comfy model/node cache across individually approved jobs
acceleration_axes.postprocessing: Full official clip nearest rationalPTS to24fps; per-case legal tail padding, crop[16,8,1280,720].
acceleration_axes.snapshot_cost: 20 intermediate AV snapshots plus final per job; measure separately

first_pair: Individual Native then root visual review then corresponding forced
